```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install test dependencies if specified in requirements.txt
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          fi
          # Install the project in editable mode, supporting both setup.py and pyproject.toml
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run pytest
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests
```

name: Tests

on:
  push:

      - master
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install test dependencies if specified in requirements.txt
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          fi
          # Install the project in editable mode, supporting both setup.py and pyproject.toml
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run pytest
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests
